integrity: The analytical proof and standalone finite checker were reviewed together; finite tests cannot prove continuum assertions. Literature-wide priority and independent audit are unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Single absorbing point on a homogeneous Brownian ring; complete instantaneous Poisson resets, independent random reset sites at strictly positive distance from target, fixed mean free first-passage cost. Laplace order does not give ordinary stochastic dominance; physical angular reflection locations not unique.
title: Convex-order bounds for spatial resetting on a Brownian ring
